packageRules.description: Patch and digest updates automerge once the required checks pass.
Only updates that change image content get the auto-release label, which makes release.yml cut a patch release after the merge; CI tooling (Makefile, workflows) automerges without one.
Core bumps (images.yaml cores:, tag@digest) in one PR. A minor/major core is a CONTRACT.md change: reviewed by hand.
The CI toolkit is consumed at @main on purpose, unpinned: no Renovate PR, it moves with main.
One PR for every actions/* bump, so one CI run instead of one per dependency.
The lint tool images (Makefile, workflows) are pinned by tag only: their regex captures no digest for docker:pinDigests to write.

customManagers.description: Pinned cores in images.yaml: tag and digest.
Container tool images pinned in the workflows and the Makefile.

Annotated version pins in the Dockerfiles and shared scripts (NODE_VERSION, NPM_VERSION, HERMES_VERSION, MISE_VERSION). currentValue must start with a digit or 'v' on purpose: it skips FIREFOX_VERSION=*, where '*' means newest in the Mozilla apt repo at build time.
